patthana16.55:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho narūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.55:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho naarūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho naarūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho naarūpī ca naanidassanasappaṭigho naarūpī ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
